**Finding: compliant** (no redline proposed).

The document's IP/data package sits at our **preferred** position:

- **§ 14.1** — Customer owns all Customer Data, Confidential Information, Customer-provided material and independently developed IP; Vendor gets only a limited processing right.
- **§ 14.2** — Customer owns each Deliverable, with an express Vendor assignment, personnel assignments, and further assurances.
- **§ 14.3 + § 13.2** — Vendor retains Vendor Technology (acceptable), but embedded Vendor Technology carries a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free, fully paid licence to use, modify and create derivative works, plus a pre-delivery disclosure duty and a bar on restrictive third-party material.
- **§ 14.4** — No joint ownership absent a separate signed instrument; feedback is voluntary and we retain unrestricted rights in it.
- **§ 1.3 / § 15.1** — Derived output is inside "Customer Data"; no sale, advertising use, commingling or model training without our written consent.

Noted in the rationale but not flagged: Deliverable ownership is conditioned on payment of the applicable Fees, and the Customer Data definition excludes truly anonymized operational telemetry — both customary and within the preferred position.
